# South Bucks Resin & Driveways

> Resin bound, block paving and gravel driveway installation and repairs for period and modern homes across South Buckinghamshire.

Serving Beaconsfield, Gerrards Cross, Chalfont St Peter, Chalfont St Giles, Little Chalfont, Amersham, Penn, Knotty Green, Seer Green and Jordans.

Key facts (2026):
- Written, insurance-backed 10-year workmanship guarantee on installations.
- Free design visit including a conservation-area / Article 4 designation check and drainage assessment; fixed, itemised written quotations.
- SuDS-compliant, permeable construction as standard (open-graded sub-bases, soakaways sized to chalk or clay ground).
- Indicative installed prices, 2026: resin bound £70–£150/m²; block paving £75–£140/m²; stabilised gravel £45–£80/m²; repairs from £250.
- Website: https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk · Email: hello@southbucksdriveways.co.uk · Phone: 01494 328592.

## Services

- [Resin Driveways](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/resin-driveways.html): UV-stable, permeable resin bound systems; bound-vs-bonded explained; build-up specification and cost table.
- [Block Paving](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/block-paving.html): Clay pavers, setts and permeable block for period frontages; patterns, edging and sub-base specification.
- [Gravel Driveways](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/gravel-driveways.html): Stabilised (gridded) gravel for larger plots and carriage drives; stone selection and cost table.
- [Driveway Repairs](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/driveway-repairs.html): Re-sanding, sunken-area re-lays, resin overlays, drainage remedials; repair-vs-replace advice.

## Guides

- [Driveway Planning Permission](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/guides/driveway-planning-permission.html): The 2008 over-5m² front-garden rule, which surfaces count as permeable, and when permission is needed.
- [Driveways in Conservation Areas & the Chilterns](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/guides/driveways-conservation-areas-chilterns.html): Conservation areas and Article 4 directions in Beaconsfield, the Chalfonts and Amersham; sympathetic materials.
- [SuDS Driveway Drainage](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/guides/suds-driveway-drainage.html): What SuDS compliance means, permeable build-ups, soakaways, chalk vs clay ground.
- [Resin vs Block Paving vs Gravel](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/guides/resin-vs-block-paving-vs-gravel.html): 2026 decision table comparing cost, lifespan, maintenance, planning and appearance.
- [Resin Driveway Cost Guide](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/guides/resin-driveway-cost-guide.html): 2026 per-m² prices with worked examples in Beaconsfield, Gerrards Cross and Penn.
- [All guides](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/guides/): Index of the guide library.

## Locations

- [Driveways in Beaconsfield](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/driveways-beaconsfield.html): Old Town conservation area vs New Town Edwardian frontages; worked 45m² example.
- [Driveways in Gerrards Cross](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/driveways-gerrards-cross.html): Large frontages and in-and-out carriage drives on clay; worked 120m² example.
- [Driveways in Chalfont St Peter](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/driveways-chalfont-st-peter.html): Village core and estate housing on clay-with-flints; worked 55m² example.
- [Driveways in Amersham](https://southbucksdriveways.co.uk/driveways-amersham.html): Old Amersham and Metro-land Amersham-on-the-Hill; worked 70m² example.
